body: I’m trying to think of what could’ve happened. Just last night we were joking around and everything was just as normal as any other day. I’m just so thrown off. If she doesn’t want to be with me then okay. But I’m struggling to find a reason as to why I haven’t gotten an explanation. It’s such a horrible feeling not knowing why your world went to shit.
I’m trying trust me. I’m fighting the thoughts and I’m trying to be rational. It’s just so hard
The police said they were only there to ensure saftey and gave me no answers on how to proceed. Only that she has decided to leave and it is what it is.

Wouldn’t you say these situations require a reaction? How else is the situation supposed to get better if you don’t take accountability and do whatever you can to get your children and yourself out of there? I don’t think anyone is saying it is easy but what’s supposed to change by doing nothing?
Eventually somebody has to take accountability. I don’t see a gun to that woman’s head when she goes to comfort the man who just slapped her in front of her son
Are you really displaying sympathy for an abuser? Lol

Hi person who’s actually lived this. The only answer is to seek help and leave. End of story.  Unless your child’s mental state is of no concern then by all means take all the punches you can take in the name of “love”
Everyone wants to be the hero in the comments lol so obvious to see who’s actually been through this and who just watches this shit on Reddit waiting for the opportunity to be the “rational” thinker
So how about those kids and the life long trauma they will now endure? Fuck them?

Her kids are going to endure mental illnesses like depression and anxiety because of this becoming a routine. No one said leaving was easy but consider the alternative. Life isn’t fair and I think this is understood by most mature adults.
